## Outcome

What user-visible or operator-visible behavior does this change complete?

## Trust, privacy, and failure behavior

Describe any effect on consent, sensitive data, network access, retention,
authentication, uncertainty, cancellation, or rollback. Write “none” only
when the boundary truly does not change.

## Verification

List the exact commands, tests, reports, or artifacts used as evidence.

- [ ] Formatting and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Linting or static checks pass for the changed scope.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the implementation.
- [ ] Fixtures and rules remain deterministic and privacy-bounded, if changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private targets, or unrelated personal data are present.

## Remaining external gate

Record any deployment, credential, signing, regional, or production evidence
that cannot be completed in the repository. Do not mark it complete by
assumption.
